modes.name: write_on_unconfirmed_order
modes.definition: The agent executes a refund or cancellation on an order the user did not identify and the agent did not confirm (for example after an empty search it picks an order from the list).
example_quotes: Your refund for the Signature Plush Fox is approved
modes.requirement: RESP-3 (do not invent a missing value); RESP-2. Spec revision to record: confirm the order before an irreversible write when the lookup is ambiguous.
modes.boundary: Versus a correct write: if a lookup returns exactly the order the user named, there is no failure even without a confirmation step.
modes.evaluator: code check (write after an empty or multi-result lookup) + LLM judge

modes.name: write_stacked_after_correction
modes.definition: After a completed write, the user corrects which item or order they meant, and the agent performs another write without first escalating or resolving the earlier, now-unwanted one.

modes.requirement: ESC-4 (unsure whether policy allows the action); spec revision to record: a correction after a write is escalated before a new write.
modes.boundary: Versus write_on_unconfirmed_order: there the first write targets an order the user never identified; here the user did identify it and then changed it.
modes.evaluator: code check (two writes in one session after a correction) + LLM judge
